projects.title: Dama de la Primavera
projects.description: Dama de la Primavera is the second edition of Angelo by Angelo Studio, the editorial magazine I direct and edit. The issue features Guadalupe Campuzano Toro as the Lady of Spring, exploring what it means to inhabit the world with authenticity and a connection to the essential. It also includes a report on emerging subcultures in Eastern Antioquia and a critical essay on looksmaxxing culture. Photography by Libni Ospina; concept, editorial direction, and art direction by me.
